Netgear GS324 24-Port Gigabit Rackmount Unmanaged Switch


The Netgear GS324 24-Port Gigabit Rackmount Switch is a high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective networking solution designed for small to medium businesses, offices, schools, and enterprise environments. With 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports, this unmanaged switch delivers fast, stable, and seamless wired network connectivity without any configuration.


Built with a durable metal chassis and fanless silent operation, the Netgear GS324 ensures long-term performance and quiet operation, making it ideal for rackmount, wall-mount, or desktop installations.


Key Features:


  • 24 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports (10/100/1000 Mbps)
    High-speed data transfer for computers, servers, printers, IP cameras, and access points.

  • Unmanaged Plug-and-Play Design
    No configuration required—simply connect devices and start networking instantly.

  • Rackmount & Desktop Ready
    Supports standard 19-inch rack mounting and flexible placement options.

  • Fanless Silent Operation
    Ideal for noise-sensitive environments like offices and classrooms.

  • Durable Metal Housing
    Enterprise-grade build quality for long-term reliability.

  • Energy Efficient Ethernet (IEEE 802.3az)
    Automatically reduces power consumption to save energy and lower operating costs.

  • Auto-Negotiation & Auto-MDI/MDIX
    Automatically detects device speed and cable type—no crossover cables needed.

  • Jumbo Frame Support (Up to 9K)
    Improves performance for large file transfers and data-intensive applications.
